goal: Track the capabilities of the client that last opened and decrypted a wallet
Allow future releases to detect when a wallet was used with an older version and re-run upgrades
Avoid expensive full-wallet rescans when loading wallets with mixed upgrade states
agreement: Strong support with all design and correctness concerns resolved
Support for adding metadata to detect mixed-format data across versions (ryanofsky)
Concept approval and subsequent ACK after feature extension and initialization questions (ajtowns)
Verified by testing wallet creation, crypto, and loading test suites on Ubuntu WSL2 (Bortlesboat)
ACKed after handling stale decrypted feature records on downgrade reload (w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it lays foundational database metadata rather than directly delivering end-user changes
Enables future automatic wallet upgrades to reliably detect downgrades without full rescans
Prevents data corruption or mixed-format edge cases when users switch between software versions
